events.verdict: Dinwiddie (DAL) immediately slides his arm off of Okongwu (ATL) as he moves around the screen.
Okongwu (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position and absorbs the incidental contact during Dinwiddie's (DAL) driving shot attempt.
Mann (ATL) briefly grasps and immediately releases Davis's (DAL) jersey as they pursue the rebound.
Thompson (DAL) rests his hand on Young's (ATL) body and the contact during the jump shot attempt is marginal.
Young (ATL) places a hand on Thompson's (DAL) body during his jump shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Martin (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball and temporarily dislodges it away from Young (ATL).
Davis (DAL) makes clean contact with the ball to block Young's (ATL) driving shot attempt.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms that Davis (DAL) is not the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Thompson (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Daniels (ATL) before he releases the pass.
Davis (DAL) moves his foot heel-to-toe to create distance on the perimeter.
Risacher (ATL) and Martin (DAL) briefly engage and disengage.
Niang (ATL) commits a take foul on Davis (DAL).
Okongwu (ATL) maintains a legal guarding position during Davis's (DAL) drive to the basket and shot attempt. Any additional contact by Mann (ATL) is marginal.
Davis (DAL) legally contests Young's (ATL) jump shot attempt and Young falls to the floor on his own accord.
